claims.claim_text: The verified baseline run achieved Accuracy 0.6346153846153846 and received the verdict baseline_verified.
The evaluated non-baseline run achieved Accuracy 0.6153846153846154 and received the verdict valid_non_improving.

The reviewed literature includes standalone evidence-grounded verification systems such as RefLens for citation verification, Evidence Coverage Evaluator for evidence coverage evaluation, and CliVER for retrieval-augmented scientific claim verification.

Within the bounded reviewed set, the selected novelty gap is that the set does not establish, via controlled ablation, whether inserting a claim-level evidence audit into an end-to-end research agent reduces hallucinated experimental details and unsupported conclusions.
